Class AprilTagVisionSubsystem

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.command2.SubsystemBase
xbot.common.subsystems.vision.AprilTagVisionSubsystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.wpilib.command2.Subsystem, org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable
@Singleton public class AprilTagVisionSubsystem extends org.wpilib.command2.SubsystemBase
Subsystem for processing AprilTag vision data. Based on the AdvantageKit sample implementation by team 6328.
